newsitem.title: UK: Stella Artois to sponsor C5 movies.
newsitem.headline: Stella Artois to sponsor C5 movies.

text.p: Stella Artois has signed a 1.3 million pound deal to sponsor films on Britain's Channel 5 television station, the company said on Thursday.

Channel 5, which will begin broadcasting on March 30, has signed film deals with Hollywood studios Twentieth Century Fox, MCA Universal and Columbia and plans to make movies a central part of its programming.
The sponsorship will run for six months from the launch of Channel 5.
"It's a natural fit for Stella Artois, as the number one premium selling lager to sponsor what will undoubtedly be our most successful segment," said Nick Milligan, sales director of Channel 5.
Stella Artois lager is brewed under licence in the UK by Whitbread.
Channel 5 is owned by a consortium comprising Pearson Plc, United News & Media, CLT of Luxembourg and U.S. investment firm Warburg Pincus.
